result.instructions: Tools for DrChrono, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DrChrono data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run drchrono_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run drchrono_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run drchrono_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. drchrono_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: drchrono_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: List/search patients in the practice, filterable by doctor, name, gender, date of birth, or last-modified time. Returns a page of patients plus `next`/`previous` URLs. DrChrono API: GET /patients.

gender.description: Filter by gender (e.g. Male, Female, Other, Unknown/Blank).

date_of_birth.description: Filter by date of birth, yyyy-mm-dd.

since.description: Return patients modified at/after this ISO timestamp (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00).

tools.name: drchrono_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Fetch a single patient's full demographic record by id. DrChrono API: GET /patients/{id}.

tools.name: drchrono_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments. The DrChrono API requires at least one of `date`, `since`, or `date_range`. Further filter by doctor, patient, or office. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /appointments.

date.description: Single day, yyyy-mm-dd. One of date / since / date_range is REQUIRED.

since.description: Appointments modified at/after this ISO timestamp. One of date / since / date_range is REQUIRED.

date_range.description: Inclusive range "start/end" as yyyy-mm-dd/yyyy-mm-dd, e.g. "2026-01-01/2026-02-01". One of date / since / date_range is REQUIRED.

tools.name: drchrono_list_offices
tools.title: List offices
tools.description: List the practice's offices/locations. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /offices.

show_archived.description: Include archived offices when true. Default false.

tools.name: drchrono_list_doctors
tools.title: List doctors
tools.description: List the providers/doctors in the practice (id, name, specialty). Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /doctors.

tools.name: drchrono_list_clinical_notes
tools.title: List clinical notes
tools.description: List clinical notes, filterable by patient, date, date range, or last-modified time. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /clinical_notes.

date.description: Filter by a single day, yyyy-mm-dd.

since.description: Notes modified at/after this ISO timestamp.

tools.name: drchrono_list_problems
tools.title: List problems
tools.description: List problem-list entries (diagnoses), filterable by patient or doctor. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /problems.

tools.name: drchrono_list_medications
tools.title: List medications
tools.description: List patient medications, filterable by patient or doctor. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /medications.

tools.name: drchrono_list_allergies
tools.title: List allergies
tools.description: List patient allergies, filterable by patient or doctor. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /allergies.

tools.name: drchrono_list_lab_results
tools.title: List lab results
tools.description: List lab results, filterable by doctor, patient, or lab order. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /lab_results.

tools.name: drchrono_list_lab_orders
tools.title: List lab orders
tools.description: List lab orders, filterable by doctor, patient, or last-modified time. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /lab_orders.

since.description: Orders modified at/after this ISO timestamp.

tools.name: drchrono_list_patient_payments
tools.title: List patient payments
tools.description: List patient payments (billing), filterable by doctor, patient, or last-modified time. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /patient_payments.

since.description: Payments modified at/after this ISO timestamp.

tools.name: drchrono_list_line_items
tools.title: List line items
tools.description: List billing line items (charges/procedures), filterable by appointment, doctor, patient, or service date. Returns a page plus `next`/`previous`. DrChrono API: GET /line_items.

service_date.description: Filter by date of service, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: drchrono_create_appointment
tools.title: Create appointment
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: creates a new appointment on the schedule. Requires doctor, patient, office, scheduled_time (ISO datetime), and duration (minutes). DrChrono API: POST /appointments.

scheduled_time.description: Appointment start as an ISO datetime, e.g. 2026-08-01T09:30:00 (required).

tools.name: drchrono_create_patient
tools.title: Create patient
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: creates a new patient record. Requires first_name, last_name, gender, date_of_birth (yyyy-mm-dd), and doctor. DrChrono API: POST /patients.

gender.description: Patient gender (required). DrChrono accepts Male, Female, Other, or Unknown/Blank.
